# Happy Home Hospital And Rehab

## About
Happy Home Hospital & Inpatient Rehab is Odisha's trusted centre for specialized neuro and spine rehabilitation, critical step-down ICU recovery, and comprehensive holistic patient care since 2021.

## Service Area
Ambulance and transfer coverage: Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Puri, Khordha, Jajpur, Nayagarh, Kendrapara, Bhadrak, Balasore

## Hospital Services
- [24/7 Emergency & Trauma Care](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Immediate medical intervention for acute neuro trauma, medical emergencies, and life-threatening conditions with 24-hour doctor coverage.
- [Critical Care & High Dependency Unit (HDU)](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Advanced hemodynamic monitoring, non-invasive ventilation, and specialized nurse-to-patient ratios for high-risk recovery.
- [Comprehensive Multi-Specialty OPD](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Outpatient consultations across neurology, orthopedics, general medicine, physical medicine, and geriatric healthcare.
- [Diagnostic Laboratory & Imaging](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Rapid biochemistry, hematology, microbiology, bedside ECG, 2D Echo, and digital X-ray facilities with express reporting.
- [Advanced Physiotherapy & Pain Clinic](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Electrotherapy, laser therapy, ultrasonic deep tissue healing, and ergonomic realignment for acute and chronic pain.
- [Oncology Palliative & End-of-Life Care](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Dedicated medical support focused on pain management, symptom control, and emotional comfort for patients with advanced illnesses.

## Rehabilitation Services
- [Post Neuro-Surgery Rehabilitation](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Comprehensive multi-phase rehabilitation following craniotomy, tumor resection, and spine surgery to restore motor control and autonomy.
- [Spinal Cord Injury Rehabilitation](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Specialized paraplegia and quadriplegia mobility retraining, bladder-bowel management, and assistive tech empowerment.
- [Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) Care](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Evidence-based cognitive restructuring, physical equilibrium restoration, and occupational therapy for severe brain trauma.
- [Advanced Bedsore & Wound Care](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Staged pressure ulcer healing using negative pressure wound therapy (NPWT), dynamic alternating air mattresses, and debridement.
- [Tracheostomy & Respiratory Support Care](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Decannulation protocols, specialized suctioning, chest physiotherapy, and round-the-clock oxygenation monitoring.
- [Cancer Palliative & Critical Care](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Holistic pain relief, compassionate symptom alleviation, nutritional support, and dignified emotional care for oncology patients.
- [Parkinson's Disease & Dementia Care](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Sensory cueing, gait stabilization, swallowing therapy, and cognitive orientation exercises designed to maximize daily independence.
- [Stroke Recovery & Paralysis Management](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Neuroplasticity-based hemiplegia recovery combining neuro-developmental therapy (NDT), functional electrical stimulation, and robotic gait.
- [Post-Surgical Orthopedic & CTVS Rehab](https://happyhomehospital.com/#services) — Structured post-operative recovery for joint replacements, complex fractures, abdominal surgeries, and coronary bypass interventions.

### Rehabilitation Services — Doctors

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What are the hospital OPD consultation timings?
Our Outpatient Department (OPD) operates Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Emergency admissions and trauma care are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

### Do you accept health insurance and TPA claims?
Yes. We assist with cashless insurance claims through leading Third Party Administrators (TPAs) and provide comprehensive documentation for private and public reimbursement policies.

### What emergency diagnostic facilities are available on-site?
Our on-site diagnostic center offers 24/7 pathology lab tests, digital X-rays, bedside ultrasound, ECG, and arterial blood gas (ABG) analysis with rapid turnaround times.

### How can I book a specialist doctor consultation?
You can book directly through our online appointment form on this website, call +91 8249914673, or send a message on WhatsApp for instant confirmation.

### Where is Happy Home Hospital located?
We are centrally located at Plot no.223, K-1 Kalinga Nagar, Ghatikia, Bhubaneswar 751029, easily accessible from Khandagiri, Patrapada, and Bhubaneswar Airport.

### What conditions are eligible for inpatient rehabilitation?
We specialize in patients recovering from stroke, traumatic brain injuries, neurosurgeries, spinal trauma, prolonged ICU stays, cancer palliative care, and severe chronic wounds requiring 24/7 medical supervision.

### What is the typical length of stay in the rehabilitation center?
Lengths of stay range from 2 weeks for acute post-surgical rehab to 6 to 12 weeks for complex stroke recovery or traumatic spinal cord rehabilitation, based on multi-disciplinary weekly assessments.

### Can family members or attendants stay with the patient?
Yes. We provide comfortable private and semi-private rooms equipped with dedicated attendant beds, attached bathrooms, and meal facilities to ensure family members are actively involved in the recovery process.

### Do you have ICU backup for emergencies?
Yes. Our facility features High Dependency Unit (HDU) and step-down critical care infrastructure with central oxygen lines, multipara cardiac monitors, defibrillators, and emergency crash carts on standby.

### How do we arrange for patient admission or transfer?
You can call our 24/7 admissions helpline at +91 8249914673. We coordinate inter-hospital ambulance transfers with oxygen and ventilator support throughout Odisha and neighboring states.
